# Pull Request

Write in English and keep the PR focused on one concern. `pnpm pr:check -- body.md` checks this description locally; CI checks it again.

## Summary

REPLACE_ME: what changed, why, and any important risks or follow-ups.

## Plan

- Plan: `docs/exec-plans/active/pr-NN-short-name.md` (use `none` only for small fixes without a new feature or experiment)

## Validation

REPLACE_ME: the `pnpm validate` result and, for viewer changes, which screenshots you inspected and what you found.

## Experiments

None. (For a new experiment: its exN, protocol, observed window and companion analysis path.)
